label: [FA] Know Your Rights
heading: [FA] Know Your Rights
description: [FA] Understanding your rights is the first step to protecting yourself and your family.

police.title: [FA] When Interacting with Police or Immigration Agents
items: [FA] You do not have to answer questions about your immigration status.
[FA] You may say: "I want to remain silent."
[FA] You have the right to refuse a search without a warrant.
[FA] Ask for a lawyer before signing anything.

ice.title: [FA] If ICE Comes to Your Home
items: [FA] Do NOT open the door without a signed warrant.
[FA] Ask to see it through the window or under the door.
[FA] You have the right to remain silent.

documents.title: [FA] Carrying Documents Safely
items: [FA] Avoid carrying your passport unless advised.
[FA] Store important documents safely at home.

disclaimer: [FA] This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. For legal assistance, please contact an immigration attorney or an approved legal service provider.
